inputs.question: Vendor may use Customer Data to train its models and retains a perpetual license to derived data. Either party may terminate on 30 days written notice.

outputs.reference: Two high risks: training on customer data; perpetual license. Termination clause is fine.

clauses.answer:
1. Vendor may use Customer Data to train its models and retains a perpetual license to derived data.
2. Either party may terminate on 30 days written notice.

args.query: vendor data use training perpetual license termination house rules

check.answer:
Clause 1: conflicts with the data-use rule (no model training on customer data without written consent); severity high; change: strike or limit to aggregated de-identified data with opt-in. Clause 1 also conflicts with the termination rule (no perpetual licenses to derived data); severity high; change: license ends at termination.
Clause 2: no conflict; mutual termination on 30 days written notice is acceptable.

report.answer:
Verdict: do not sign as written; two high-severity conflicts.
1. High: training on Customer Data conflicts with the data-use rule. Change: strike, or limit to aggregated, de-identified data with opt-in.
2. High: perpetual license to derived data conflicts with the termination rule. Change: the license ends at termination.
The 30-day mutual termination clause is fine.
This is a rules check, not legal advice.
